definitions.explanation: The mathematical function that gives the exponent to which a base must be raised to produce a given number. Common in high-school math, science, and engineering contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{対数|たいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned about logarithms in high school.

examples.japanese: {対数|たいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using logarithms makes large numbers easier to handle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マグニチュード⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対数|たいすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}されている→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{1|いち}⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{30|さんじゅう}⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Earthquake magnitudes are expressed on a logarithmic scale, so a difference of 1 means about 30 times the energy.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧ (corresponding) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常用対数|じょうようたいすう}: common logarithm (base 10)
- {自然対数|しぜんたいすう}: natural logarithm (base e)
- {対数|たいすう}{関数|かんすう}: logarithmic function
- {対数|たいすう}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: logarithmic graph

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指数|しすう}→指数：20414_shisuu⟧: exponent — the inverse concept; the power to which a base is raised
- {累乗|るいじょう}: power, exponentiation — the operation of raising a number to an exponent
